items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I lived at Villette and Alex.

ctx.x: What place is that? I lived at Villette and Alex. That's long after you moved over here.

Yeah, I was down in Sox's land then. Then we moved from there and we moved back in, at least they call it Dubin, over to the Vida. Had a little place to go back there. You know where they got that water winks? Back there. I lived back there. What did you call it? They called it, I called it, I called it water winks, you know.
